messages:
emily: heads-up - saw duplicated downstream charges from our nightly batch job after we rolled the new retry lib. multiple workers retried in lockstep and webhook consumer got the same payload twice.
raj: oof. which variant of the retry lib? did we change jitter semantics?
emily: we upgraded to retry v2.1 which switched from math/rand seeded by time.Now().UnixNano() to a seeded global RNG seeded by current unix second for performance. containers started by cron within the same second ended up with identical RNG streams. logs: 
```
2026-03-25T03:00:00.001Z WARN retry: got 429 attempt=1 backoff_ms=0.0 job=batch_421
2026-03-25T03:00:00.001Z DEBUG retry: jitter_ms=7 seed=1610 worker=1
2026-03-25T03:00:00.001Z DEBUG retry: jitter_ms=7 seed=1610 worker=2
2026-03-25T03:00:00.203Z INFO sender: POST /webhook job=batch_421 idempotency=absent
2026-03-25T03:00:00.204Z INFO sender: POST /webhook job=batch_421 idempotency=absent
```
emily: two POSTs 1ms apart.
tori: why is idempotency missing? we added safe_replay in most paths. was batch job using older sender?
emily: the batch was using the lightweight http-sender path to reduce memory, which omitted Idempotency-Key unless the job explicitly built a SafeReplayEnvelope. config had ENABLE_SAFE_REPLAY=false to lower noise in logs.
raj: so three failures: coarse seed, global RNG reused across workers, and opt-out of idempotency.
tori: fix suggestions:
- change seeding to use crypto/rand or combine high-res time + pid + monotonic counter at startup;
- switch to per-worker RNG instances instead of a global RNG to avoid correlation;
- flip ENABLE_SAFE_REPLAY default to true for batch/sender;
- add a small jitter floor (2-5ms) even in deterministic/dev modes and document the tradeoffs.
emily: +1. also add an ingress check that logs when multiple workers start within same second with identical seed to catch this during deploy.
raj: can we make the sender idempotent by default without impacting a lot of users? attach Idempotency-Key based on job_id + attempt counter hash if user hasn't provided one.
tori: that's workable: generate Idempotency-Key = sha256(job_id + task_uuid + attempt) and set header only if not present. ensures safe replay while preserving the explicit user-provided key when they want custom semantics.
emily: agree. also add an e2e: spin up N workers in CI with deterministic start times and run the herd sim to validate dedupe.
eng-bot: created issue INF-2833: "batch worker RNG seeding + sender idempotency defaults" assigned to @raj.
monitor-bot: alert suppressed: multiple duplicate delivery alerts from staging between 03:00-03:05 UTC. watchers: payments-team.
raj: action items:@raj - PR to switch seeding & per-worker RNG; @tori - flip ENABLE_SAFE_REPLAY default + adapt sender to attach key when missing; @emily - add CI herd-sim test and ingress seed-check; @qa - run staging smoke after merge.
emily: thanks all, big win to catch this before GA. leaving a short note in onboarding: "Avoid disabling safe replay for batch jobs; deterministic backoff config may cause duplicated side-effects when multiple workers start simultaneously." :warning:
